name: Ilyan Khan
title: 2nd Year Computer Systems Engineering
bio: AI Engineer and Product Manager exploring the intersection of open-source LLMs, AST security guardrails, and scalable software architecture — backed by 4 technical internships and a focus on clean, reliable code.
philosophy_quote: The deepest way to understand any system is to build it from first principles. I connect foundational computer systems principles with practical AI to create fast, reliable software.

philosophy_principles.title: First-Principles Exploration
philosophy_principles.description: Rather than relying solely on high-level APIs, I dive into fine-tuning open-source models (LoRA/PEFT), analyzing dataset representations on Hugging Face, and writing low-level C++ algorithms to master runtime execution and memory efficiency.

philosophy_principles.title: Deterministic & Useful Software
philosophy_principles.description: From student management systems to AST security firewalls for LLMs, I prioritize software that is fast, mathematically verifiable, and practically useful in real hands.
